concerns.text: The definition of the adolescent period is vague ('birth year to roughly the mid‑teens'). Without an explicit age range (e.g., 12‑18 years) the `adolescent_exposure_ratio` cannot be computed deterministically, making FR-001 untestable.
The Minimum Listen Threshold is mentioned but no concrete numeric threshold is provided. Test scripts cannot know which user‑track pairs to filter, so the requirement is not verifiable.

The permutation‑test methodology does not specify the number of permutations (or stopping criteria). Without a defined iteration count the null distribution cannot be reproduced, rendering the success criterion unmeasurable.
SC‑004 references a warning threshold as `[deferred]`. A success criterion must be fully quantified; the placeholder prevents automated verification of whether a warning should be emitted.

Both acceptance scenarios for User Story 2 depend on a match‑rate value that is left as `[deferred]`. Because the concrete input value is undefined, the scenarios cannot be instantiated in a test, violating the testability of the user story.
